outcome: cesarean section for non-reassuring fetal heart rate
umbilical cord blood pH at term
cohort: Pregnant women (37-40 weeks) with a diagnosis of borderline amniotic fluid index (AFI) compared to those with normal AFI.
finding: Pregnant women with borderline AFI had significantly lower gestational age at delivery, a higher rate of cesarean section due to non-reassuring fetal heart rate, increased incidence of low birth weight, lower 5-min Apgar scores, and lower umbilical artery pH compared to those with normal AFI.
